options.name: autostart
options.description: Specify if a given network should be started automatically on system boot.

options.name: command
options.description: In addition to state management, various non-idempotent commands are available. See examples. Modify was added in Ansible version 2.1.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the network being managed. Note that network must be previously defined with xml.

options.name: state
options.description: Specify which state you want a network to be in. If 'active', network will be started. If 'present', ensure that network is present but do not change its state; if it is missing, you need to specify xml argument. If 'inactive', network will be stopped. If 'undefined' or 'absent', network will be removed from I(libvirt) configuration.

options.name: xml
options.description: XML document used with the define command. Must be raw XML content using C(lookup). XML cannot be reference to a file.
